thread:
Aisha: Heads-up: new hire onboarding demo flakes when you background the browser for a few seconds while streaming. Steps to repro in quickstart.
Tom: repro steps?
Aisha: 1) open quickstart in Chrome, 2) start streaming response, 3) turn on throttling (Slow 3G), 4) switch to another tab for ~6s, 5) switch back. UI sometimes shows "Unexpected token in JSON" and the stream handler stops.
Ben: which sdk/version?
Aisha: browser-sdk v0.10.3 from the quickstart distro. Node sample app handles the same scenario fine.
Rina: can you paste the network stream payloads?
Aisha: snippet from Network > Response: ```data: {"id":"demo1","chunk":"{\"text\":\"hi\"}"}

:keepalive:

data: {"id":"demo1","chunk":"{\"text\":\"there\"}"}
``` After resume the client sometimes receives the trailing newline merged like `...}\n\n:keepalive:\ndata:` into a single buffer and our parser treats `:keepalive` as payload which confuses the JSON reassembly.
Tom: sounds like the browser ReadableStream is returning a chunk boundary that doesn't align with SSE record boundaries after throttling. Our SSE parser assumes each `data:` line arrives intact.
Ben: yep. Node's fetch implementation gives nicer chunk splits so it masked the bug.
Rina: short-term fixes: 1) onboarding doc note to disable throttling for demo, 2) server can emit keepalive as `:hb\n` (no `data:`) or send an explicit chunk delimiter like `data: [CHUNK_END]\n\n`.
Aisha: added a note to quickstart README so new hires don't hit it.
Tom: longer-term SDK change: make the browser SSE parser resilient to line merges. Ideas: buffer partial lines and treat lines starting with `:` as comments only if they begin at a line boundary. On `JSON.parse` errors, try to join with previous buffered fragment and retry once. Add a small debounce window (30-80ms) before failing so slow resumes get reassembled.
Ben: + add a debug flag to log raw byte boundaries to help correlate with network traces during CI e2e.
Rina: I'll file an issue and add a throttled-background e2e test to sample-apps matrix.
ci-bot: Created issue devex/sample-apps#1792: "quickstart: browser streaming parse failure on tab background + network throttle"
Tom: I'll send a patch to the parser: keep last partial line, re-evaluate on next chunk, and unit tests that simulate merged `:keepalive` + `data:` sequences. Also include a feature-flagged retry-before-fail behavior.
Aisha: awesome, that should keep demos stable for onboarding. Thanks all :rocket:
